findings.description: When n is zero, the function always returns the start date regardless of whether it falls on a weekend, violating the specification that requires moving to the following Monday.
findings.evidence: Input: start=2026-11-05 (Saturday), n=0. Returned 2026-11-05 but expected 2026-11-07.

findings.description: For a weekend start and n>0, the algorithm incorrectly adds an extra business day, returning the day after the expected Monday.
findings.evidence: Input: start=2026-11-05 (Saturday), n=1. Returned 2026-11-08 but expected 2026-11-07.

review.summary: Candidate implementation fails to correctly handle weekend starts, both for zero and positive business days.
